sentences.en: The primary motivation of the Crusades was economic, not religious.
sentences.zh: 十字军东征的主要动机是经济上的，而不是宗教上的。

sentences.en: Armenians participated in the Crusades alongside European Christians.
sentences.zh: 亚美尼亚人曾与欧洲基督徒一同参与十字军东征。

sentences.en: The American government has recently been on a crusade to wipe out drug trafficking.
sentences.zh: 美国政府最近一直在致力于打击毒品走私的斗争。

senses.zh: 史十字军东征；（宗教性的）圣战；改革运动
